name: Nord (theme palette)
description: The hex values behind the Nord theme in `frontend/src/styles/themes/nord.ts` were read from this project's `src/nord.css`. Nord publishes no light theme; LeapMux's two light variants are a DERIVATION that uses Nord's own Snow Storm ramp for backgrounds and Polar Night for text, with the Frost and Aurora accents unchanged. The brighter of the two paints the page white and moves that Snow Storm ramp out onto the surfaces above it.
